presets.name: CMP 01 Sub Triangle
presets.purpose: OSC 1 alone, triangle, 32': low-frequency shape and tuning.
presets.listen: Fundamental and faint upper harmonics; the first played F2 sounds at F0 (21.83 Hz). Check the next three notes too, not just the subsonic end.

presets.name: CMP 02 Shark Register
presets.purpose: OSC 2 alone, shark tooth, 16': the asymmetric triangle/saw shape.
presets.listen: The character between a triangle and a saw, with OSC 1 and OSC 3 muted.

presets.name: CMP 03 Reverse Current
presets.purpose: OSC 3 alone, reverse saw, 8', keyboard control on.
presets.listen: The reverse saw's spectrum and transient shape. A reverse saw can sound much like an ordinary saw; inspect polarity and waveform as well as listening.

presets.name: CMP 04 Square Octave
presets.purpose: OSC 1 alone, square, 4': octave-up oscillator tracking.
presets.listen: Hollow odd-harmonic tone; input C4 is sounding C5, and the final input C5 sounds C6.

presets.name: CMP 05 Wide Skyline
presets.purpose: OSC 2 alone, wide pulse, 2': two-octave shift and upper-register harmonics.
presets.listen: Compare with 04: the same sounding C5/E5/G5/C6 pitches, but a different pulse width and oscillator.

presets.name: CMP 06 Narrow Needle
presets.purpose: OSC 3 alone, narrow pulse, 8': high keyboard register.
presets.listen: Thin nasal harmonics on F5/A5/C6; pitch and aliasing at the upper end of the original keyboard.

presets.name: CMP 07 Twin Beat
presets.purpose: OSC 1 + 2, saws at 8', OSC 2 ten cents sharp.
presets.listen: Slow beating on held A3. Ten cents is deliberately between lines; use the displayed cents/tuner, rather than an approximate knob angle.
presets.hardware: The stored +10 cents is relative to OSC 2's nominal centre. Match the measured beat rate against OSC 1, including each device's natural centre mismatch and drift.

presets.name: CMP 08 Octave Floor
presets.purpose: OSC 1 + 3, a 16' triangle over a 32' square.
presets.listen: The square sub-octave and softer upper fundamental; check both voices still track over the four keys.

presets.name: CMP 09 Fifth Lantern
presets.purpose: OSC 2 + 3, 8' triangle and saw; OSC 3 seven semitones higher.
presets.listen: A fifth inside one synth voice. One MIDI key at a time; this is oscillator interval tuning, not polyphony.
presets.hardware: The hardware's +7 marking is only a guide. Tune OSC 3 to exactly +7 semitones relative to OSC 2, then record the actual knob position.

presets.name: CMP 10 Three Floors
presets.purpose: OSC 1 + 2 + 3 at 32'/16'/8': three octave layers, three shapes.
presets.listen: Low saw, middle shark tooth and high square stay in octave relationships; listen for mixer colour as all three sum.

presets.name: CMP 11 Copper Pluck
presets.purpose: Low-pass filter contour and zero loudness sustain: a short two-saw bass.
presets.listen: Filter opens at attack then closes; loudness falls to zero even if a key were held. The gaps expose retrigger and residual tails.

presets.name: CMP 12 Slow Bloom
presets.purpose: Independent filter/loudness attack, nonzero sustain and released decay.
presets.listen: Volume rises before the filter has finished opening; after the 2.80 s note-off, listen to both contour tails.

presets.name: CMP 13 White Lotus
presets.purpose: The unchanged factory White Lotus: narrow-pulse bass, a third-harmonic filter ring and OSC 3 LO filter modulation.
presets.listen: The held narrow-pulse fundamental and its resonant ring an octave and a fifth above. C3 followed by C4 exposes full keyboard tracking and the approximately 11 Hz modulation of the ring. The factory's fine positions are preserved rather than rounded to lines.
presets.hardware: Set OSC 1 to 8' narrow pulse, mixer 10; all other mixer sources OFF. Use LO filter, cutoff -2.14, emphasis 7, both tracking switches ON, contour amount 0. OSC 3 is a triangle at LO, CONTROL OFF and mixer OFF; tune its rate to approximately 11 Hz. FILTER MODULATION ON, OSCILLATOR MODULATION OFF, MOD MIX 0. Match the modulation excursion with the hardware MOD DEPTH/MIDI wheel. The CA-72 preset keeps MODULATION 0.17 exactly; this MIDI clip sends no CC 1, because 7-bit CC cannot represent 0.17 exactly. Load White Lotus before playing the clip and leave the modulation controller untouched.

presets.name: CMP 14 Ladder Whistle
presets.purpose: Filter self-oscillation, no VCO in the mixer, full keyboard tracking.
presets.listen: Quiet noise excites the resonant ladder. Listen for the filter's near-sine tone and octave tracking. These keys control filter pitch; cutoff -2 does not promise concert tuning.
presets.hardware: Keep NOISE at 1 on both devices to start oscillation reproducibly; do not tune the filter between notes in a take.

presets.name: CMP 15 High Pass Reed
presets.purpose: High-pass filter, resonance, contour, two-thirds keyboard tracking.
presets.listen: Low fundamentals thin out, with the upper harmonics retained. Repeat the same take in LO to isolate the filter-mode change.

presets.name: CMP 16 Joined Glide
presets.purpose: GLIDE with a continuous monophonic phrase and single triggering.
presets.listen: Joined notes have zero gap, ordered note-off before note-on: never two held keys. Listen to up/down slide time and whether the filter attack restarts. Hardware multi-trigger must be OFF.
presets.hardware: Set GLIDE to 6. For manual playing, use a single-note legato line; the supplied MIDI uses zero-gap joins. Repeat with GLIDE at 0 for the control take.

presets.name: CMP 17 White Snap
presets.purpose: White noise through fast contours: percussion without oscillators.
presets.listen: Broadband hiss, transient attack and the decay slope. MIDI C3 triggers the contour; with tracking off it does not pitch the noise.

presets.name: CMP 18 Pink Weather
presets.purpose: Pink noise, slow filter/loudness attack and sustained resonant wind.
presets.listen: Darker noise spectrum than 17, with a moving resonant band. For a controlled noise-colour comparison, repeat 17 changing only WHITE to PINK.

presets.name: CMP 19 Triangle Motion
presets.purpose: OSC 3 as an untracked LO triangle LFO, pitch destination only.
presets.listen: Smooth pitch modulation on held C4. OSC 3's mixer switch stays OFF; it remains a modulation source. Repeat an octave higher to check the LFO rate stays fixed.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 as source, NOISE/MOD SRC rather than the separate LFO, MOD MIX fully to OSC 3, MOD DEPTH 10. Use CC 1 = 6 as a reproducible starting depth, then match measured pitch excursion.

presets.name: CMP 20 Falling Window
presets.purpose: OSC 3 as an untracked LO reverse-saw LFO, filter destination only.
presets.listen: A repeated asymmetric cutoff sweep with a sharp reset. Pitch modulation is OFF; listen to filter motion rather than a pitch slide.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 and NOISE/MOD SRC, MOD DEPTH 10, CC 1 = 26. Match rate and cutoff excursion by measurement; the MIDI wheel transfer curve is not guaranteed identical on another hardware unit.

presets.name: CMP 21 Audio Alloy
presets.purpose: Keyboard-tracked OSC 3 at audio rate modulates oscillator pitch.
presets.listen: Metallic sidebands from audio-rate exponential FM. OSC 3 is inaudible in the mixer but audible through modulation. This is not oscillator sync or ring modulation.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3/NOISE sources, MOD DEPTH 10 and CC 1 = 13; keep OSC 3 mixer OFF and OSC 3 CONTROL ON. Match modulation depth before comparing sidebands.

presets.name: CMP 22 Mixed Turbulence
presets.purpose: Midpoint MOD MIX: LO square OSC 3 plus noise, both destinations.
presets.listen: Stepped motion with random flutter. The mixer noise switch is OFF: noise still reaches the modulation circuit. Repeat at MOD MIX 0 and 10 to separate the two sources.
presets.hardware: Select OSC 3 and NOISE/MOD SRC, MOD MIX 5, MOD DEPTH 10, CC 1 = 13. Use the built-in noise source with no cable in MOD SOURCE; match depth, then compare distributions rather than individual noise samples.

presets.name: CMP 23 External Window
presets.purpose: External audio through preamp, low-pass filter and keyboard-gated contours.
presets.listen: All oscillator/noise mixer switches OFF, FEEDBACK 0. Play external-input.wav into the hardware EXT IN and the plug-in side chain at the same measured input level. Keys change filtering and gating; the source's pitch remains 220 Hz.
presets.hardware: Connect the supplied mono test signal to EXT IN, which breaks the hardware's automatic output return. The plug-in receives that same file on its side chain. Match input voltage; an interface's dBFS is not an analog voltage.

presets.name: CMP 24 Return Furnace
presets.purpose: External-input feedback and mixer overload from the hardware-accessible loop.
presets.listen: Feedback changes the mixer/preamp distortion, not just listening volume; observe OVERLOAD. Compare repeat takes with the return muted and present at matched listening loudness.
presets.hardware: For the closest topology, patch one PHONES output channel into EXT IN and use the independent PHONES volume; start at its 6 mark and EXT IN 6. CA-72 FEEDBACK 6 is a starting setting, not a promise of equal loop gain. The normalled uncabled return also works but depends on MAIN VOLUME; record which route and measured return level you used.
